annotator: Codex assistant, independent manual blind review
sampling: All63 original2026snapshot comments remaining after exclusion of60previous reference IDs and21teacher-development IDs; all12discussion threads retained. Selected by ID before reading comments; no selection by sentiment.
limitation: Exploratory labels by an assistant, not human ground truth. Single-annotator ambiguity remains, especially implicit product references and sarcasm. No teacher/student predictions or previous reference labels were consulted.
targeting_rule: Label only the comment sentiment toward ChatGPT, including its explicitly identifiable app/features. Use the immediate parent and title only to resolve a clear referent; a matching title alone does not make general AI, other products, people, or unrelated replies relevant. Neutral factual target comments are C; unrelated or insufficient target evidence is F.
